WORDS: item_text is the administered Chinese, taken verbatim from the deposit's own header row (29/29 identical after stripping the leading 'N.' / 'N. ' numbering, the only alteration). language=Chinese. Three source typos are kept literally, not corrected: item 14 '优化教学教学流程' (doubled 教学); item 20 '知情4' (evidently 知情同意, informed consent, the phrase used in the MoE standard JY/T 0646-2022); item 23 '他人的数进行' (evidently 数据, data, is missing a character). TRANSLATION: no English item wording exists in the paper (which gives only the domain names and item ranges) or in either supplement, so item_text_translated is this project's own translation from the Chinese (translation_source=machine_translation) -- owes an issues-page entry. OPTIONS: the administered Chinese anchors are not published anywhere in the paper or deposit. The paper's English endpoint labels ('1 = strongly disagree, 5 = strongly agree', lowercase as printed) sit in the base option_text for resp 1 and 5 with option_text_translated empty, the documented fallback shape (precedent rosharudin_2023_ders18); resp 2-4 are unlabelled in the source and left blank, not padded. No instructions published; instructions NA. Single trivial section: the five domains (awareness q1-5, skills q6-8, application q9-18, social responsibility q19-24, professional development q25-29) are the paper's analytic grouping and do not appear as headings or prompts in the deposit. MAPPING: mapping_basis=data_labels -- the deposit's header row ties each column to its text and the header's own leading number equals its column position 1..29. Because the dc_N code does not appear in the source and the processing script is not in the repo (derivation could be positional or number-preserving), the mapping was re-derived rather than exempted: verify_tian2026_digital_competence.R joins the live table to the deposit on id (764/764 ids match) and live dc_N agrees with deposit item column N for 764/764 respondents on all 29 items, while the best agreement with any other column is 668/764 (dc_27/dc_28); the paper's Table 2 domain sum scores also reproduce (e.g. application 41.516/6.431 live vs 41.520/6.430 published). Live dc_1 and dc_2 use only 3-5 and dc_21/27/28/29 four levels; these reproduce the deposit exactly, so they are the data, not a defect. RIGHTS: the scale is the authors' own instrument, developed 'drawing primarily on China's teacher digital literacy standard (JY/T 0646-2022) and on instruments reported by Chen and Min [16] and Yu and Zhang [17]' (two Chinese journal articles), and its wording is published in the study's CC BY 4.0 article supplement. No fee, permission, non-commercial, no-derivatives or no-redistribution clause could be found or quoted for the instrument; not a commercially published instrument; not in instrument_rights_register.csv. Silence is permission; no register row written (rounds may not write ship rows).

EVIDENCE 2 (distribution channel): US VA National Center for PTSD measure page https://www.ptsd.va.gov/professional/assessment/adult-sr/ies-r.asp (fetched 2026-09-11, sha256 0e12825222a3fc9c88457d5e23b74424514c45480e531c0a647f813063f2ac48) does not distribute the items: 'To Obtain Scale: Daniel Weiss, PhD, Department of Psychiatry, University of California - San Francisco ...' and 'Measures developed outside of the National Center can be requested via contact information available on the information page for the specific measure.' EVIDENCE 3 (why the reproductions don't launder it): the Hartford Institute for Geriatric Nursing 'Try This' sheet https://hign.org/sites/default/files/2020-06/Try_This_General_Assessment_19.pdf (sha256 eb9c478f6b1cc99e687c3f36fd8794d69ad59b96296e6684d9ff08b4fad4c9d0) grants reuse under its OWN non-commercial term ('Permission is hereby granted to reproduce, post, download, and/or distribute, this material in its entirety for not-for-profit educational purposes only') and names Weiss as contact -- a reproducer's NC licence, which would block on its own and in any case is not the originator's grant. VERDICT REASONING: the originator distributes the wording only on request and has on record refused a request to reproduce it in a free open-source tool; permission-required reserves a right, and IRW hosting redistributes to users whose use IRW cannot condition, so it blocks regardless of the CC BY 4.0 PLOS deposit. WEAKNESS STATED HONESTLY: the refusal is quoted from a third party (CamCOPS), not from a page Weiss publishes; no statement on the holder's own page was locatable (the Guilford chapter is paywalled, not read). Same evidentiary shape as the SHAPS block at batch_177 (clause via CamCOPS). No register row written by this agent (scope); the orchestrator/Ben should decide whether to add an IES-R 'block' row. BLOCK REACHES SOMETHING: item codes IES1..IES22 carry no wording, so withholding item text does withhold the instrument. ESCALATION / CORPUS CONSISTENCY: two IES-R item-text tables shipped before the 2026-09-05 rulings and were never re-audited against them -- ali_2021_iesr (batch_003, English, data_labels) and beck_2021_iesr (batch_008, official German IES-R of Maercker & Schuetzwohl 1998, a derivative). (article XML sha256 fa5104e0...f521; Tables 1-4 are demographics/fit indices only). S1 Data .sav (doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0195229.s001, sha256 3c376798e77250f397df32e8381d2008ca572b3787945c9802fac1647372dd22): variable labels are bare names ('IES1'..'IES22'); value labels on all 22 items are 0='Not at all', 1='A little bit', 2='Moderately', 3='Quite a bit', 4='Extremely'. RETRY TEST: NO -- determinate rights block (holder reserves reproduction; refusal on record). An unchanged retry cannot change it. Would change only if Ben rules the second-hand CamCOPS report plus the VA request-only channel insufficient (ship-shaped cases must be escalated, not decided by a round), or the holder publishes a grant.

CAVEAT 2 -- ENGLISH IS LOOSER THAN THE JAPANESE: the administered Japanese asks whether it is important to explain 'the effects that malignant tumours and their treatment have on sexual and reproductive functions (including, where there is no effect, that there is none)'; the study's own English renders this as 'the information regarding their sexual and reproductive functions'. The English is shipped as published (translation_source=study_supplied), not rewritten. STEP 3b: matches -- 2 items, 4-point importance scale (3 levels observed), exactly questionnaire IV Q1-Q2; the dictionary Description ('2-item scale on nurses' perceived importance of explaining SRH to AYA cancer patients') agrees. The questionnaire is the study's own survey (part of a Japanese national AYA cancer care survey led by Horibe), not a published or commercial instrument; both language versions are published by the authors in CC BY 4.0 PLOS ONE supplements; instrument_rights_register.csv has no matching row; no fee, permission, NC, ND or no-redistribution clause located, so silence is permission.
